info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Realestate Listings Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Status API provides real-time access to the status of real estate listings. It enables users to monitor the availability and condition of properties, ensuring timely updates on market changes. This API is particularly useful for real estate agents, property managers, and prospective buyers who need to stay informed about listings. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate listing status information into their applications, enhancing user experiences and facilitating informed decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of all listings available in the system. It can be used to check if listings are active, pending, or inactive, providing essential insights for management and reporting.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of listings. It allows clients to specify criteria for filtering or querying the current listings' status.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned the current status of the listings.

ListRealestateListingsStatusRequest.description: Represents the status of the listing operation in JSON format.

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful or not.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the request.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the operation.

state.description: The current state of the listings operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the request.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the operation.

ListRealestateListingsStatusResponse_200.description: Response schema for the operation that retrieves the status of listings.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the entry was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit details for the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request. A lower value generally signifies faster response times.
